source: Failla and Rossetti, Bluesky Social Dataset v3 (https://zenodo.org/records/14669616, doi:10.5281/zenodo.14669616)
notes: Labels are the dominant language of authored, language-tagged posts, not country or nationality.
Edges join users who follow each other.

Only original posts count; each distinct language tag of a post gives one vote and ties go to the lexicographically smallest code (78 invalid JSON records of 233079055 excluded; 2196344 labeled users).
The 20 languages with the most labeled users are kept, then the largest connected component (ties by smallest original anonymous user ID).
Source archives: followers.csv.gz md5:33eb37998142681ab0a993765c18b5cb, user_posts.tar.gz md5:a8ea3b82b9c85485077fde935ddf1161.

No per-user data are included: rebuild edges.npy, labels.npy and user_ids.npy with prepare_bluesky.py. Upstream removal requests can change a rebuilt graph, so its checksums may differ from those below.
